title: Work and applications — in sentences
summary: Use the English meaning as well as the Swedish context to choose or type the missing word or phrase. Practise employment words and workplace requests. Som introduces a relative clause; så att can introduce an intended result.

s01.sentenceGloss: That is the colleague who works at night.
s01.note: Som introduces a relative clause about kollegan.

s02.sentenceGloss: She works as a teacher at a school.

s04.sentenceGloss: Speak clearly so that everyone can understand you.
s04.note: Så att introduces the intended result.

s05.sentenceGloss: I receive my pay for the work every month.

s06.sentenceGloss: Protect your head with a helmet.

s07.sentenceGloss: We take a break and drink coffee.
s07.note: Ta en rast: take a break.

s08.sentenceGloss: In my CV I write about my experience from previous jobs.
